title: Resolution-aware ranking (D-2026-99 class), per-quantity equivalence, the sensitivity cross-check's refusals
note: RE1-RE7 tiers, selection and comparison; EQ1-EQ8 equivalence statuses and contract refusals; SE1-SE2 the cross-check's resolution refusal and no-substitution rule (the SALib paths run under stack-verify's full leg).

mutations.name: RE1_touching_bounds_distinct
mutations.rationale: intervals that touch are ordered, though their exact values may be equal

mutations.name: RE2_neighbours_not_components
mutations.rationale: a wide interval no longer holds later overlapping values in its tier

mutations.name: RE3_selection_splits_a_tier
mutations.rationale: a top-k selection takes part of a tier, decided by nothing the method resolves

mutations.name: RE4_ambiguity_called_resolved
mutations.find: return Selection(k, tuple(selected), t.keys, room, AMBIGUOUS)
mutations.replace: return Selection(k, tuple(selected), t.keys, room, RESOLVED)
mutations.rationale: a selection below resolution is reported as decided

mutations.rationale: a value with no declared resolution is ranked as if exact (roundoff decides)

mutations.name: RE6_disagreement_unreported
mutations.rationale: methods ordering a pair oppositely are reported as consistent

mutations.name: RE7_different_keys_compared
mutations.rationale: rankings of different parameter sets are compared

mutations.name: EQ1_bound_too_tight
mutations.rationale: two honest results within their own bounds are called different

mutations.name: EQ3_unit_change_ignored
mutations.rationale: a unit change passes as a numeric difference

mutations.name: EQ4_contract_numbers_allowed
mutations.replace: pass  # a contract may carry numbers
mutations.rationale: a tolerance written into a contract is accepted

mutations.name: EQ5_invariants_ignored
mutations.rationale: an invariant failing on one side does not affect the status

mutations.name: EQ7_unclassified_output_equivalent

mutations.name: EQ8_parameters_unchecked
mutations.rationale: results on different inputs are compared as reproductions

mutations.name: SE1_unresolved_response_ranked
